title: iMC idle recovery skips retained clock and reset states
description: Idle controller recovery skips retained clock and reset states, and the discovered callers ignore initializer errors and enter discovery.
not_established: This is a conditional robustness gap, not a reproduced persistent loop.
remediation: Native selective-recovery+B08 batches verify ownership, drain writers and TSOD, check queued commands and propagate failures through a worker-safe PEIM exit. C1 local, C2 physical. 16 tests, 1,070 native executions. The historical unconditional-reset experiment is excluded.
